name: What is involved in a window opening modification project?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a window opening modification project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A window opening modification project typically involves altering the existing structure to change the size, shape, or location of a window. This can range from enlarging a small window to a larger one, converting a window to a door, or relocating an opening entirely. The process often includes structural engineering assessments, framing adjustments, new window installation, and finishing work on both the interior and exterior. Preparation involves understanding your local building codes and obtaining necessary permits, which can vary by jurisdiction within our service areas like Alameda or Emeryville.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window opening modifications alter the size, shape, or location of a window, involving structural work, framing, installation, and finishing. Permitting and local building codes are key considerations.
